title: 2027 Admissions Officially Open: Secure Your Child's Place (Limited Slots)
excerpt: Admissions for the 2027 Academic Year are now active for Play Group, PP1, PP2 and Grades 1 through 6. With limited slots per class, early booking is recommended.
body:
Gracious Love Academy is pleased to announce that enrollment for the 2027 Academic Year is officially open across all levels: Play Group, PP1, PP2, and Grades 1 to 6.

To preserve our promise of personalized learning where every child is known and supported, each class has strictly limited slots available. Prospective parents from Jomoko and the greater Thika community are encouraged to book an early campus tour and learner interview.

Term 1 2027 begins on Monday, 4th January 2027. Early applicants will benefit from priority school van route allocation and early uniform fitting.

title: Class of 2026 Celebrates Graduation: Ready for Grade 1 in January 2027
excerpt: Our PP2 graduating class celebrated their milestone in colorful academic gowns with choral verses, certificate presentations, and heartfelt family blessings.
body:
Our PP2 graduating class reached an inspiring milestone in our annual graduation ceremony! Dressed in full academic gowns, the pupils performed heartwarming recitations, choral verses, and songs for an audience of proud parents and guardians.

The School Headteacher personally presented each graduate with their certificate of completion, commending their growth in literacy, numeracy, and character.

Congratulations to our bright class! They are thoroughly prepared, confident, and eager to step into Grade 1 this January 2027.

title: Expanded School Transport Routes & Upgraded Safety for 2027
excerpt: Starting January 2027, our safe school van service will expand coverage across Jomoko, Landless, and surrounding Thika neighborhoods.
body:
In response to parent requests, Gracious Love Academy is expanding its morning and afternoon school van routes for the 2027 academic year. Routes will cover broader sections of Jomoko, Kingdom Seekers area, SK Suites surroundings, and neighboring Thika communities.

Our vans are operated by certified, vetted drivers with dedicated staff attendants on board to ensure every child is escorted safely to and from their doorstep or designated pick-up point.

title: Annual School Excursion: Inspiring Nature & Outdoor Learning
excerpt: Pupils enjoyed an unforgettable outdoor excursion complete with scenic gardens, recreational play, and a communal lunch picnic by the pool.
body:
At Gracious Love Academy, we believe education extends far beyond classroom walls. Our pupils participated in an unforgettable excursion day featuring guided nature walks, recreational games, and a joyful communal picnic.

Activities like this strengthen social bonding, encourage teamwork, and create cherished memories that inspire children throughout their school journey.
